write_raw_bids() shouldn't require info['line_freq']
According to the [BIDS specs](https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/04-modality-specific-files/03-electroencephalography.html#sidecar-json-_eegjson), `PowerLineFrequency` may also be `'n/a'`. This should be our default if `raw.info['line_freq']` has not been set. Currently, we'd raise an exception:

```python
ValueError: PowerLineFrequency parameter is required in the sidecar files. 
Please specify it in info['line_freq'] before saving to BIDS (e.g.
raw.info['line_freq'] = 60 or with --line_freq option in the command line.).
```

We should only raise a warning in this case.

Thoughts?
